task_completion.description: Log in to Odoo as admin
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Odoo dashboard or 'Settings' menu is visible, and the user profile icon indicates 'admin' is logged in.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the 'Working Times' or 'Working Schedules' configuration list
task_completion.visual_evidence: A list view of working schedules is shown, typically under Settings -> Technical -> Resource -> Working Times or within the Payroll/Employees app configuration.

task_completion.description: Open the 'Standard 40 hours/week' schedule for editing
task_completion.visual_evidence: The form view for the schedule named 'Standard 40 hours/week' is displayed, showing the 'Working Hours' tab with a list of shifts.
The VLM should see a row in the working hours table where the Day of Week is Friday and the Work From/To times are 13:00 and 17:00 respectively.

task_completion.description: Delete or remove the Friday afternoon shift entry
task_completion.visual_evidence: The row for Friday (13:00-17:00) is no longer present in the list of working hours, or is being deleted via the trash icon/delete action.

task_completion.description: Ensure Friday morning (08:00-12:00) and Mon-Thu shifts are preserved
task_completion.visual_evidence: The working hours table still shows Friday 08:00-12:00 and two shifts (morning/afternoon) for Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. The 'Save' button is clicked or the record is shown as saved.

integrity.description: The agent used the Odoo web interface rather than executing raw SQL or shell scripts to modify the database
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on Odoo buttons (like 'Edit', 'Save', or the delete icon), and navigation through the Odoo UI.

integrity.description: The agent modified the existing schedule rather than deleting the entire schedule and creating a new one
integrity.visual_evidence: The ID or breadcrumbs indicate the agent is editing the existing 'Standard 40 hours/week' record rather than starting from a blank 'New' form.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the live Odoo instance provided
integrity.visual_evidence: The URL bar shows the expected local or provided Odoo domain, and the UI elements match the Odoo version used in the environment.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target schedule is named 'Standard 40 hours/week'. In Odoo's backend, Friday is represented by day index 4. The goal is to remove the shift starting at 13:00 on Friday while keeping the shift ending at 12:00 on Friday. All shifts for Monday through Thursday (Days 0-3) must remain untouched (typically 08:00-12:00 and 13:00-17:00).
